name: adaptui
description: AdaptUI — Cross-platform, AI-powered accessibility browser application

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@adaptui/desktop run build
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/shared-types packages/security packages/semantic-model packages/ui-schema packages/browser-core packages/ai-core packages/ai-providers packages/speech-core packages/command-agent packages/personalization packages/accessible-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@adaptui/desktop run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:security && npm run test:a11y
